title: New major hospital, Brisbane: electrical
workplace: New major hospital with a hospital tower, two level basement and rooftop helipad, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Ward cable trays and cabling
swms.task: Install cable trays and pull cables through the ward ceilings and risers from scissor lifts more than 2 m above the floor, and terminate the cables at the new switchboards before they are energised.

facts.fallControl: Scissor lifts with guardrails are used for all work above 2 m, and platform ladders only for work below 2 m.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.
facts.isolationProcedure: Circuits are isolated, locked with personal locks and danger tagged, and tested de-energised by a licensed electrician before work. Each worker holds their own lock.

steps: Install cable tray, containment and cabling at height
Pull cables and handle cable drums
Work on or near energised parts
